mapper.insert: INSERT INTO images (stored_name, original_name, content_type, size_bytes, url, uploaded_by) VALUES (#{storedName}, #{originalName}, #{contentType}, #{sizeBytes}, #{url}, #{uploadedBy})
mapper.select: SELECT id, stored_name, original_name, content_type, size_bytes, url, uploaded_by, created_at FROM images WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, stored_name, original_name, content_type, size_bytes, url, uploaded_by, created_at FROM images ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
